evidence_items.explanation: CaLM evaluates 28 models across 92 causal targets and reports worsening performance as causal tasks become more complex. This supports persistent causal weaknesses in the tested population, but does not establish the capabilities of every model available in December.

evidence_items.explanation: ContPhy finds failures by GPT-4V and Gemini on physical properties and dynamics, particularly cloth and fluids, while also recording successes on some rope and ball tasks. The models receive sampled video frames, so perception and the input format may contribute to failures; these are also early-2024 model evaluations.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5.1, Judgment of behavior; prompting controls in section 5.3
evidence_items.explanation: SimpleToM finds a gap between identifying mental states and applying them: o1-preview reaches 59.5% on behavior judgments despite stronger performance on the preceding tasks. Material counterevidence within the same study is that targeted reminders and reasoning prompts produce high scores, including a 97.1% average for Claude-3.5-Sonnet under the combined intervention.

evidence_items.locator: Figure 8(a) caption; section 4.4 and appendix A.5
evidence_items.explanation: Adding irrelevant information to mathematical word problems produces substantial failures, including for o1-preview. The study also acknowledges strong o1 performance on other variants; these results establish a robustness weakness rather than an absence of mathematical ability.

This revised study reports strong causal-task performance and tests on datasets created after model training cutoffs, making it material counterevidence to an overly dismissive reading. It also reports unpredictable errors and prompt sensitivity, so it does not establish that causal reasoning as a whole was robustly solved.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved causal and physical evaluations do not adequately cover the strongest models available by 6 December 2024. Failures by their earlier tested models cannot alone settle the field-wide statement.
No retrieved evaluation establishes dependable generalization across an entire named area, sufficient to contradict the claim.

The social-reasoning results depend substantially on prompting. Their strong intervention results do not establish broad robustness, but prevent treating baseline failures as the full account of model capability.
